{{Quote|Lord Vader, there's been an incident at the Yaga Minor shipyards.|Captain Luitt, to Darth Vader|<ref name="LOTS" />}}
The '''Yaga Minor shipyards''' were [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[shipyard]]s located on<ref name="LOTS" /> the [[Planet|world]]<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Yaga Minor]],<ref name="LOTS" /> which was situated in the [[New Territories]]<ref name="New Territories">The {{GalaxyMapPoster}} places the [[Yaga Minor system]], and therefore [[Yaga Minor]] itself, in the area of [[Realspace|space]] ''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' identifies as the [[New Territories]].</ref> and [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] regions.<ref name="Galaxy Map">{{GalaxyMapPoster}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Yaga Minor system]]</ref> In [[14 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Lords of the Sith]]'' to [[14 BBY]].</ref> members of the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] led by the resistance fighter [[Pok (Twi'lek)|Pok]] [[Mission to hijack an Imperial weapons shipment|hijacked]] an Imperial [[weapon]]s shipment at the [[shipyard]]s. The rebels fled in a [[Thief|stolen]] [[freighter]] and attempted to rendezvous with the Free Ryloth Movement's leader—[[Cham Syndulla]]—and his [[Starship|ship]]. However, Pok and his team were pursued by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], who had been informed of the theft by his subordinate, [[Captain]] [[Luitt]]. After Vader [[Death|slaughtered]] Pok and his team, Syndulla decided to escalate his [[Ryloth Insurgency|insurgency]] against the Empire.<ref name="LOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current [[canon]], the Yaga Minor shipyards were mentioned in the [[2015]] novel ''[[Lords of the Sith]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="LOTS" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Yaga Minor shipyards/Legends|Yaga Minor shipyards]] first appeared in the [[1993]] novel ''[[The Last Command]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] as the third installment of ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]''.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
